description: Source code for managing patch IDs in a Git-like version control system, including functions for initializing, comparing, iterating, and adding patch IDs associated with commits.

classes.name: struct patch_id
classes.description: Represents a patch ID associated with a commit, including its hash and linkage in a hashmap.

classes.name: struct patch_ids
classes.description: Holds a collection of patch IDs and associated diff options.

methods.name: patch_id_defined
methods.description: Checks if a commit has a valid patch ID based on its parent commits.

methods.name: commit_patch_id
methods.description: Calculates the patch ID for a given commit.

methods.name: patch_id_neq
methods.description: Compares two patch IDs for inequality, loading full IDs if necessary.

methods.name: init_patch_ids
methods.description: Initializes a patch_ids structure for a repository.

methods.name: free_patch_ids
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a patch_ids structure.

methods.name: init_patch_id_entry
methods.description: Initializes a patch_id entry for a commit.

methods.name: patch_id_iter_first
methods.description: Returns the first patch_id for a commit.

methods.name: patch_id_iter_next
methods.description: Returns the next patch_id in iteration.

methods.name: has_commit_patch_id
methods.description: Checks if a commit has an associated patch ID.

methods.name: add_commit_patch_id
methods.description: Adds a new patch ID for a commit to the collection.
